note: The 4-clip family intro video (fun, exciting, introductory, family time). Each clip: 'scene' = the still picture (Flux), 'motion' = what happens (Wan 2.2). Claude joins them afterwards with titles, a 'Sawasdee!' voice and nongchang.co.uk.

clips.scene: pops out of a glowing tablet on the coffee table of a cosy family living room in the evening, surrounded by golden sparkles and orange marigold petals, while a mum, a dad, a girl about 7 and a boy about 10 sit on the sofa behind, looking amazed. His short teal scarf is neatly knotted around his neck with no long loose ends, and both front legs are clearly separate from the scarf.
clips.motion: the baby elephant rises up out of the glowing tablet in a shower of golden sparkles and marigold petals and waves his trunk hello, the children jump up from the sofa with huge delighted smiles and the parents laugh, fast playful camera push-in, keep his short scarf knotted neatly around his neck and his four legs clearly separate

clips.scene: bounces happily on the rug in a bright living room next to a tablet, with a mum, a dad, a girl and a boy sitting around him cheering, golden stars floating in the air. His short teal scarf is neatly knotted around his neck with no long loose ends, and both front legs are clearly separate from the scarf.
clips.motion: the family cheers and high-fives as golden stars burst from the tablet, the baby elephant does a happy little dance and claps his trunk, lots of laughter and bouncing energy, keep his short scarf knotted neatly around his neck and his four legs clearly separate

clips.scene: sits on a sunny kitchen counter like a real baby elephant with both front feet resting flat on the counter, holding a ripe mango up with his trunk only, beside a plate of mango sticky rice; a smiling dad, a grinning boy, a laughing mum and a girl stand right next to the counter close to him. He has exactly four legs, all on the counter, and no hands. His short teal scarf is neatly knotted around his neck with no long loose ends.
clips.motion: the baby elephant lifts the mango with his trunk and nods happily, the dad points at the mango and the boy proudly says a word, the mum laughs and the girl claps, warm cosy family moment, keep his four legs resting on the counter and his short scarf knotted neatly around his neck

clips.scene: stands in a golden Thai temple garden at sunset with floating lanterns in the sky, with a happy family of a mum, a dad, a girl and a boy standing right beside him in a close group, everyone facing the camera and smiling, all fully visible, calm empty sky in the top third. He stands on four legs like a real baby elephant. His short teal scarf is neatly knotted around his neck with no long loose ends.
clips.motion: the whole family and the baby elephant press their hands together in a Thai wai greeting, bow, then wave happily at the camera, lanterns rise slowly into the sky, camera gently pulls back, magical and celebratory, keep his short scarf knotted neatly around his neck and his four legs clearly separate
